resources.string: Enter the exam date, daily study time, subjects and lessons. Review the plan before saving.
Use old timetable to avoid busy hours
Only selected sessions are added to to-dos. Enable notifications in settings for reminders.
Choose or take a timetable photo. AI reads only the image, then you review the draft before saving.
Describe your study goal. AI suggests concrete tasks for you to review and edit.
For example: Review functions, complete two math practice tests, and learn English vocabulary this week.
This is an AI draft. Review every item before adding it to your schedule.
The photo is blurry, cropped, or its days and periods are unreadable. Retake the full timetable in good light.
This photo is not a timetable. Choose an image showing weekdays, periods, and subjects.
Describe the subject, goal, or tasks you need to finish so AI can create a plan.
This image cannot be read or is too large. Choose another JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
AI could not produce a valid draft. Try again with a clearer image or description.
Could not read the timetable. Check your connection and try again.
Could not create a plan. Check your connection and try again.
Allow camera access to photograph your timetable.
Could not open the camera. You can choose an image from your library.
